# Synthetic media-network fixtures

These files contain invented observers and events under reserved `.example` domains. They test data contracts only; they are not results of the pilot and make no claim about a real source, person, audience, or network.

The bundle exercises overlapping memberships, participant-share arithmetic, a mirrored channel, sibling observers in one brand family, a failed feed excluded from the current denominator, cross-network stories, and a story that is ineligible because two observers supply only one independent family. `lineage-scenarios.json` records expected future outcomes for factor permutation, gradual drift, birth, retirement, split, merger, and uncertain continuity. Stage 4 must run the lineage implementation against those expectations.
